verification.method: The official two-page district table was rendered at 200 dpi and visually reviewed. Weekly and Nth-weekday rules were expanded, then official 2026 fiscal-year closure dates were removed.
verification.coverage: Twenty user-facing area choices preserve the five Kawanoe schedules and 07:00 highlighted subareas, five Mishima schedules, three Doi schedules and three Shingu schedules.
verification.limitations: Weather, snow and road-freezing cancellations are not known in advance and are never generated. Mishima collection on 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-15 is preserved exactly as the official closure notice states.
